response.original_title: Khushi - The Princess of the Jungle
response.overview: Welcome to Khushi – The Princess of the Jungle, a heartwarming 3D animated kids cartoon filled with magical forest adventures, forest friends, and fun learning stories. Join Khushi, a brave and curious girl, and her brother Chottu as they discover a hidden magical forest where glowing animals, mystical creatures, and nature come alive. Along the way, they meet amazing forest friends—from playful animals to magical beings—who guide them through exciting adventures.
